findings.observation: Grathael displays Level 45, Difficulty 3 dots and Chunk Seas of Mist; no Zone or Continent label is printed. The quest notes separately name Seas of Mist and a specific location, but this creature page does not verify a spawn.

Athanalor displays Level 45, Zone Ceros Isle, Difficulty 3 dots, Chunk Ceros Isle and Continent Kojan. These agree with the quest note region label but provide no grid or loc, so the conflicting quest grid variants remain unresolved.

Both creature pages warn that only one source records the NPC and details are unconfirmed. The archive creature and quest aggregation do not supply independent historical corroboration. Names alone do not establish canonical quest-contact identity.
Grathael Loot (0) and No loot recorded preserve missing evidence rather than an operative empty loot table.

Athanalor Loot (1) lists Luminous Tuft of Fur with a curse attribution and warns that drop rates are sampled frequencies of unknown sample size. No developer probability or canonical item identity is established.
Neither creature page supplies quest dialogue, ceratescryer mechanics or rewards. Level 45 creature headers do not resolve the quest displayed Level 24 into a minimum player level.

pages.article_html:
Unicorns Of Kojan

Level 24 · Adventuring · Lomshir

Objectives

Find the unicorns Grathael and Athanalor. They are on separate small islands in the Kojani Archipelago. Speak to them and return to Adaenyl at Shadow's End with the ceratescryer. - Reestablish Contact with Grathael - Reestablish Contact with Athanalor - Ceratescryer (0/1)

Description

Adaenyl says, "I am now finding two unicorns far to the north of us, in the Kojani Archipelago. Their names are Grathael and Athanalor, and they each seem to be on their own small islands." "Aid these unicorns as you aided Raynien. Take the ceratescryer to them so that they can link with me, then return the device to me so I may point it in another direction to search for more unicorns."

What they say

On offering it

Adaenyl says, "I am now finding two unicorns far to the north of us, in the Kojani Archipelago. Their names are Grathael and Athanalor, and they each seem to be on their own small islands." "Aid these unicorns as you aided Raynien. Take the ceratescryer to them so that they can link with me, then return the device to me so I may point it in another direction to search for more unicorns."

Recorded by vg.curse.com.

Grathael is in the Seas of Mist (-20, 10) on the southern island. /loc 38274, 73028, 10499 in Seas of Mist (-20, 10) Athanalor is in the Ceros Isle (-19, 9) on the southeastern island. /loc 49806, 35190, 6121 in Ceros Isle (-19, 8) Closest riftstone in in Tanvu.<gallery captionalign="left"> unicorn10.jpg|Grathael and Athanalor.
